summary: Iter 16 security-only fix verification (backend only). Confirmed both Bandit findings are resolved and NO regression: (a) 42/42 pytest tests PASS with 3 harmless skips (matches iter 15 baseline exactly), (b) exec() builtin no longer present at module scope in scripts/generate_questions.py — replaced with importlib.util.spec_from_file_location + spec.loader.exec_module (safe standard-library module loader, not Bandit B102), (c) no hardcoded test_password literal in backend_test.py — now generated per-run via os.environ.get('KITE_TEST_PASSWORD', 'Tp-' + secrets.token_urlsafe(16)), (d) _load_existing() still returns 2193 questions (unchanged), (e) backend_test.py imports secrets as expected, (f) /api/health returns 200.
critical_code_review_comments: Both security fixes are minimal, targeted, and idiomatic. importlib.util.spec_from_file_location is the correct replacement for exec() when loading a sibling module by path; it does not trigger Bandit B102 and provides the same functional outcome. secrets.token_urlsafe with the 'Tp-' prefix ensures generated passwords always satisfy typical registration policies (non-alphanumeric prefix + entropy).

Minor: backend_test.py still hardcodes base_url default 'https://kite-trivia-quest.preview.emergentagent.com/api'. Consider reading from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for portability, but low priority since main pytest suite uses its own client.
Pre-existing (not introduced this iter): server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). FastAPI lifespan handlers would be cleaner but non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: None. Registration tests use per-run randomized emails+passwords.
